request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
Until when can I cancel my electricity contract because of the price increase?

response.text:
Here's what I found about the special right to cancel your electricity contract because of the price increase:

- Your electricity provider Stadtwerke Musterstadt sent a price-increase letter [doc:doc_asph8a6ddy4e], with a special right to cancel under § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG, without the normal notice period.
- The letter says the price change takes effect "01.11.2026" and your cancellation must arrive before that date to use this special right — the letter says this in the same clause [doc:doc_asph8a6ddy4e].
- Ordnung has **not** computed a separate "cancel-by" to-do for this special right (only the ordinary cancellation dates for the contract are stored [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5], and a payment reminder for the new, higher advance payment of 54.00 € due Sun 15 Nov 2026 [item:itm_v3m35j0h5pwv]).

Because this deadline isn't in Ordnung's own computed record, I'd suggest:
- Double-checking the exact effective date on your paper/PDF letter, since cancellations only count once they arrive with the provider (not when sent).
- If you want to use this right, you can draft the cancellation letter now via "Draft letter" in Ordnung and send it well before 1 Nov to be safe.

If in doubt about the deadline or wording, Stadtwerke Musterstadt's customer service or a consumer advice centre (Verbraucherzentrale) can confirm it.
